description: A Spring MVC Controller class managing client-related web operations such as creating, editing, viewing details, and adding similar clients.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling client management web requests such as add, edit, view details, and create similar client.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Displays form to add a new client and populates status list.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Processes form submission to save a new client after validation.

methods.name: editClient
methods.description: Displays form to edit an existing client by ID.

methods.name: seveClient
methods.description: Processes form submission to save edited client data after validation.

methods.name: clientDetails
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a client including contracts and events.

methods.name: addSimilarClient
methods.description: Displays form to create a similar client based on existing client data.
